title: Four temperaments test: sanguine, choleric, melancholic or phlegmatic? — cv.cm
description: Free four temperaments test: rate 20 statements to see whether you are mostly sanguine, choleric, melancholic or phlegmatic, with your score for each. No sign-up; answers stay in your browser.
lede: Lively, driven, thoughtful or easygoing? Rate 20 statements to find which of the four classical temperaments sounds most like you, and how much of the other three you have.
about: The four temperaments are one of the oldest personality ideas: Greek physicians linked them to the four bodily humors, and the philosopher Immanuel Kant later described them as types of feeling and acting. Sanguine people are sociable and cheerful, choleric people driven and decisive, melancholic people deep and careful, phlegmatic people calm and steady.

The humor theory is long gone, and modern psychology describes personality with traits such as the Big Five instead. The four types are still a handy, memorable way to talk about style. The statements here were written for cv.cm; most people are a mix, so look at all four scores, not just the top one.

faq.a: Sanguine (outgoing, cheerful, spontaneous), choleric (ambitious, decisive, quick to anger), melancholic (thoughtful, detail-minded, sensitive) and phlegmatic (calm, patient, easygoing).

faq.q: Is the four temperaments theory scientific?
faq.a: Not in its original form: the idea that body fluids shape character was abandoned long ago. The four styles roughly line up with combinations of extraversion and emotional stability, which are well studied. Treat the result as a conversation starter.
Yes. Most people have one or two strong temperaments and some of the others. Your result shows all four scores so you can see your blend.
None. Each has strengths and blind spots: the sanguine brings energy, the choleric drive, the melancholic depth and the phlegmatic calm.

sanguine.name: Sanguine: the lively one
sanguine.body: You are warm, talkative and quick to enjoy the moment, and people feel welcome around you. You bring energy to any group. Watch out for spreading yourself too thin: finishing what you start makes your enthusiasm count.

choleric.name: Choleric: the driven one
choleric.body: You are decisive, ambitious and happiest when you are making things happen. In a crisis, people look to you. Your challenge is patience: slowing down to listen helps others follow you willingly.

melancholic.name: Melancholic: the thoughtful one
melancholic.body: You are deep, careful and loyal, with high standards and a rich inner life. You notice what others miss and do things properly. Try not to let perfectionism or old worries hold you back.

phlegmatic.name: Phlegmatic: the calm one
phlegmatic.body: You are steady, patient and easy to be around, and you keep the peace when others get heated. People trust your calm. Remember that your own wishes matter too: speak up for them before others decide for you.
